```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) (h : A ⊆ B) : A ∪ B = B := by
  rw [Set.union_comm]
  exact Set.subset_union_of_subset_right h B
  exact Set.union_subset_right
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact Set.union_subset_right
  · rw [Set.union_comm]
    exact Set.subset_union_of_subset_right h B
```
